# Miwah Styles

> Miwah Styles is a Lagos, Nigeria-based wig styling and revamping brand led by Miwah. Brand tagline: "Revived, Refined & Remarkable."

## Business facts
- Business name: Miwah Styles

- Turnaround: confirmed per booking; no fixed turnaround promise is currently published.

## Services
- Wig styling: curl setting, silky pressing, waves, bob shaping, layering, fringe cuts and blowout styling.
- Wig revamping and restoration: washing, conditioning, detangling, reshaping and curl restoration.
- Lace customization and wig construction: knot bleaching, plucking, tinting, lace repair/replacement and cap adjustments.
- Wig colouring: custom colour enquiries, ombré, highlights, blonde and burgundy tones, toning and colour correction.
- Wig installation and care: glueless or glued installation enquiries, edge styling, baby hairs and maintenance sessions.
